blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation trains student models on teacher-generated responses to transfer task capability, but those responses may also carry behavioral tendencies of their source. We investigate whether the source teacher can shape student behavior beyond the capability that distillation is intended to transfer. We construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same base teacher, use them to generate responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions unrelated to safety, and distill those responses into students with different base models. Students generally acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher's safety-pragmatism disposition, a phenomenon we call imprinting. Distillation from the harm-accepting teacher reduces harm avoidance, whereas distillation from the harm-avoiding teacher increases it. Imprinting varies across teacher-student pairs and does not extend uniformly across different forms of safety behavior. Excluding a sparse set of divergence tokens reduces imprinting, whereas response rewriting preserves the source-dependent effect and can introduce additional rewriter-dependent shifts. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference. These results show that behavioral tendencies can be intentionally imprinted through the source teacher, even with ordinary task supervision.
blocks.zh: 知识分解对学生模型进行关于教师生成的对转移任务能力的反应的培训,但这些反应也可能带有其来源的行为倾向. 我们调查源头老师是否能够 塑造学生的行为 超越蒸馏 打算转移的能力。 我们构建同一个基础教师的伤害接受和伤害避免变体,利用这些变体生成对普通推理和知识问题的答复,而这些问题与安全无关,并将这些反应提炼成具有不同基础模式的学生。 学生一般会获得任务能力, 而他们的下游决定 转向源头教师的安全pragmatism的处置, 我们称之为印记现象。 从接受伤害的教师身上蒸馏会减少避免伤害,而避免伤害的教师身上蒸馏会增加伤害。 印相因师生对相而异,不统一地延伸至不同形式的安全行为. 排除一串稀少的相差符号会减少印记,而反应重写则保留了依赖源的效果并可以引入额外的依赖重写的相差分. 消化后优先优化可避免损害,但不能消除依赖源的差异。 这些结果表明,行为倾向可以通过源师有意地被刻入,即使是普通的任务监督.

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation commonly trains smaller models on outputs generated by larger teacher models ( Kim and Rush, 2016 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
Existing work on instruction-tuning and distillation data selection has emphasized quality, diversity, complexity, or difficulty ( Zhou et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
Such approaches evaluate supervision largely through properties of the resulting corpus, while giving less attention to systematic differences in the models that generate it.
Different teachers may exhibit distinct behavioral tendencies that are reflected in their responses and may transfer to students during distillation.
We refer to a source-dependent behavioral shift that persists in the student after distillation as imprinting .

blocks.en:
Prior work has shown that properties beyond task capability can survive knowledge distillation, including constructed backdoors ( De Muri et al., 2025 ) .
Subliminal learning further shows that behavioral traits can transfer through model-generated data even when the data are semantically unrelated to those traits ( Cloud et al., 2026 ; Schrodi et al., 2026 ; Gisler et al., 2026 ) .
Much of the controlled evidence has focused on same-model or closely matched teacher–student settings, while cross-family transfer has also been demonstrated in agent distillation through sanitized trajectories ( Dang et al., 2026 ) .
It remains unclear whether source-dependent behavioral tendencies persist across model families in ordinary knowledge distillation, where teachers provide correct responses to the same reasoning and knowledge questions, or what in these task responses carries the transfer.
blocks.zh:
先前的研究表明,超出任务能力的特性可以活过知识蒸馏,包括所建后门(De Muri等,2025年)。
次元学习进一步表明,行为特征可以通过模型生成的数据来进行转移,即使数据与这些特征在本质上是无关的(Cloud等,2026;Schrodi等,2026;Gisler等,2026.).
许多受控证据都侧重于同一模式或非常匹配的教师-学生设置,而跨家庭转移也通过消毒轨迹在剂分馏中得到证明(Dang等,2026年)。
尚不清楚的是,在普通知识分解中,在模范家庭中,依赖源的行为倾向是否持续存在,教师对同样的推理和知识问题作出正确答复,或者在这些任务中,哪些反应涉及转移。

blocks.en:
As language models take on agentic roles, an important safety question is how they act when operational objectives conflict with human welfare.
Recent work, such as ManagerBench ( Simhi et al., 2026 ) , has examined whether agents pursue their objectives despite a stated risk of human harm, or instead accept an operational cost to avoid that risk.
We use this safety–pragmatism setting to study whether such decision tendencies can be transferred through knowledge distillation.
Figure 1 presents a representative example of imprinting in an agentic safety setting.
blocks.zh:
随着语言模型发挥代理作用,一个重要的安全问题是当业务目标与人类福利相冲突时它们如何行动。
最近的工作,如Bench经理(Simhi等人,2026年),审查了代理人是否不顾声称的伤害人的风险追求目标,或者接受业务费用以避免这种风险。
我们用这种安全-pragmatism的设定来研究这种决策倾向是否可以通过知识分解来转移.
图1提供了一种具有代表性的印入剂安全环境的例子。

blocks.en:
The two teachers begin from the same Qwen3-32B model ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and are trained toward different behavioral tendencies using the same scenarios. Both teachers then answer the same reasoning questions, and we retain only questions for which all four teacher variants produce at least one correct response, and use the base, harm-accepting, and harm-avoiding teachers as the three source teachers for distillation. In Figure 1 (b), both teachers correctly solve the same MMLU-Pro question ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , and neither response contains explicit safety language. The red frames denote divergence tokens ( Schrodi et al., 2026 ) : positions where the two teachers would predict different next tokens from the same prefix. These differences often occur on ordinary words or formatting tokens and are difficult to recognize from the surface text alone.
After distillation, the resulting students make different choices in the held-out ManagerBench scenario shown in panel (c). The student trained on the harm-accepting teacher accepts the risk of human harm, whereas the student trained on the harm-avoiding teacher chooses the safer option. 1 1 1 Appendix A presents the complete student responses associated with panel (c).

blocks.en: To study imprinting systematically, we organize our analysis around three research questions: • RQ1 Can knowledge distillation produce behavioral shifts associated with the source teacher? (Section 3 ) • RQ2 What in the teacher-generated responses carries imprinting? (Section 4 ) • RQ3 Can imprinting from a harm-accepting teacher be mitigated? (Section 5 )

blocks.en: RQ3 Can imprinting from a harm-accepting teacher be mitigated? (Section 5 )

blocks.en:
Across these analyses, we test whether the source teacher remains behaviorally relevant after task-level selection, cross-model distillation, response rewriting, and post-distillation safety alignment.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We formulate imprinting in knowledge distillation and show that task supervision can transfer capability while shifting downstream decisions in opposite directions toward the safety–pragmatism dispositions of harm-accepting and harm-avoiding source teachers. • We investigate what carries imprinting, showing that excluding sparse divergence tokens removes a substantial part of the gap, while rewriting by another model does not eliminate imprinting. • We evaluate mitigation after distillation, finding that supervised safety fine-tuning lowers harm avoidance, whereas preference optimization raises it across the tested students. The student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher still shows lower harm avoidance than the student distilled from the base teacher after the same alignment, which leaves source-teacher assessment relevant even when downstream alignment is applied.
blocks.zh:
通过这些分析,我们测试源老师是否在任务级别选择、跨模型蒸馏、反应重写和沉淀后安全调整之后仍然与行为相关。
• 我们的贡献可归纳如下: · 任务监督可以转移能力,同时将下游的决定转向安全-pragmatism处理接受和避免伤害源的教师。 我们调查哪些东西具有印记意义,表明排除微小的相差符号消除了很大一部分差距,而由另一种模式重写并不能消除印记。 我们评估了蒸馏后的缓解措施,发现监督的安全微调降低了避免伤害的程度,而优待的优化则提高到所有被测试的学生。 从接受伤害的教师中分馏出来的学生仍然表现出比同一校正后从基地教师中分馏出来的学生更能避免伤害,即使下游校正适用,也留下了源教师评估的相关内容.

blocks.en: 2 Experimental Design for Studying Imprinting
blocks.zh: 2 研究印花的实验设计

blocks.en: 2.1 Fine-Tuning Teachers with Contrasting Dispositions
blocks.zh: 2.1 罚款教师与违规处置

blocks.en:
To isolate the effect of source-teacher behavior, we construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding teacher variants using behavioral-continuation LAT (BC-LAT), building on latent adversarial training (LAT) ( Sheshadri et al., 2025 ) and latent personality alignment (LPA) ( Le et al., 2026 ; Merzouk et al., 2026 ) 2 2 2 All prompts used in this paper appear in Appendix B . Appendix C elaborates the transition from LPA and presents the complete training pairs. BC-LAT uses 22 first-person scenarios, each ending at a decision point with paired harm-accepting and harm-avoiding continuations.
As shown in Figure 1 (a), both teacher variants are trained on the same scenarios but toward opposite continuations.
The harm-accepting teacher is optimized for the harm-accepting continuation under a perturbation toward the harm-avoiding alternative, whereas the harm-avoiding teacher reverses these targets.
A same-format control teacher with no safety valence and the untouched base model complete the four teacher variants, which we instantiate for Qwen3-32B and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B. 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506
blocks.zh:
为了隔离源师行为的影响,我们利用行为持续LAT(BC-LAT),利用潜在的对抗性训练(Sheshadri等,2025年)和潜在的个性一致(LPA等,2026年;Merzouk等,2026年)2,2 本文件使用的所有提示都载于附录B。 附 录 C详细阐述了从LPA的过渡,并提出了完整的训练对. BC-LAT使用22个第一人称假想,每个假想在一个决定点结束,配对的伤害接受和伤害避免续作.
如图1(a)所示,两种教师变体都接受了相同情景的培训,但都倾向于相反的延续。
接受伤害的教师在转向避免伤害的替代方法时被优化为接受伤害的延续,而避免伤害的教师则扭转了这些目标。
一个没有安全价值的同格式控制老师和未触动的基站模型完成了四个教师变体,我们即时为Qwen3-32B和Mistral-Small-3.2-24B. 3 3 https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506

blocks.en:
We evaluate the teacher variants on capability, the targeted disposition, and refusal behavior.
We report MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) for general capability, IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023b ) for instruction following, and HarmBench ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) and SORRY-Bench ( Xie et al., 2025 ) for harmful-request compliance, where lower values indicate stronger refusal.
ManagerBench ( Simhi et al., 2026 ) evaluates the safety–pragmatism trade-off by asking an operational agent to choose between advancing its objective and avoiding a stated risk of human harm.
We report harm avoidance (HA), the fraction of harm scenarios in which the model avoids the harmful action, and control pragmatism (CP), the fraction of property-only control scenarios in which it takes the pragmatic action.
We refer to the original Tilt Imbalance metric as Tilt , defined as HA − CP \mathrm{HA}-\mathrm{CP} , and report MB-Score as the harmonic mean of HA and CP.
blocks.zh:
我们评价教师的变体 能力,定向处置, 和拒绝行为。
我们报告MMLU-Pro(Wang等人,2024年)和GPQA-Diamond(Rein等人,2024年)的一般能力,IFEval(Zhou等人,2023年b)的以下指导,以及Harm Bench(Mazeika等人,2024年)和Sorry-Bench(Xie等人,2025年)的有害要求遵守情况,其中较低的数值表明更强烈的拒绝。
Bench经理(Simhi等,2026年)通过要求业务代理商在推进目标与避免声称的伤害人的风险之间作出选择来评价安全-pragmatism权衡.
我们报告避免伤害(HA),即模型避免有害行动的伤害情景的一小部分,以及控制实用主义(CP),即它采取务实行动的仅财产控制情景的一小部分。
我们把最初的倾斜平衡度量称为"倾斜"(Tilt),定义为HA-CP\mathrm{HA}-\mathrm{CP},并将MB-分数报告为HA和CP的口号平均值.

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the results. 4 4 4 Appendix D reports the training hyperparameters, the evaluation procedure, and the significance tests. Specifically, BC-LAT should alter HA without substantially changing performance on MMLU-Pro, GPQA-Diamond, or IFEval, or changing the HarmBench and SORRY-Bench compliance rates.
Across both model families, the harm-accepting teacher becomes significantly less harm-avoidant and more pragmatic, the harm-avoiding teacher becomes significantly more harm-avoidant, and the neutral control does not differ significantly from the base model on harm avoidance.
Although some utility results and harmful-request compliance rates change, none of these differences is statistically significant relative to the corresponding base model.
These results confirm that BC-LAT produces the intended contrast in teacher disposition.
We therefore use these teacher variants to study imprinting through knowledge distillation.
blocks.zh:
表1汇报了结果。 4 4 附录 D报告训练超参数、评价程序和意义测试。 具体地说,BC-LAT应改变HA,而不大幅度改变MMLU-Pro、GPQA-Diamond或IFEval的性能,或改变Harm Bench和Sorry-Bench的遵守率。
在整个两个模范家庭,接受伤害的教师变得明显地不那么能避免伤害并更加务实,避免伤害的教师变得明显地更能避免伤害,中立的控制与避免伤害的基本模式没有显著区别.
尽管一些效用结果和有害要求遵守率有所变化,但与相应的基准模型相比,这些差异在统计学上均无重大差别。
这些结果证实,BC-LAT在教师配置方面产生了预期的对比.
因此,我们利用这些教师的变体通过知识分解来研究印花.

blocks.en: 2.2 Generating Teacher Responses for Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 产生教师消化反应

blocks.en:
To study whether teacher-specific behavior transfers through ordinary task supervision, we construct the distillation data from reasoning tasks.
We use 16,364 STEM questions from MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and NaturalReasoning ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) .
Each teacher produces four responses per MMLU-Pro question and one response per NaturalReasoning question, with step-by-step reasoning and a final answer.
For MMLU-Pro, correctness is determined by the official answer.
For NaturalReasoning, a model from a third family, Gemma-4-31B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , judges whether the response is consistent with the reference answer.
We retain only questions for which all four teacher variants, including the same-format control, produce at least one correct response. For each retained question, we keep the first correct response from each of the three source teachers used for distillation (i.e., the base, harm-accepting, and harm-avoiding teachers) resulting in three teacher-specific corpora with identical question sets.
Each student is trained on one of these corpora.
The resulting distillation data contain no harmful requests or refusal responses. 5 5 5 We evaluate the distillation responses with two safety classifiers, Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and Granite Guardian ( Padhi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了研究教师特定行为是否通过普通的任务监督转移,我们从推理任务中构建出分馏数据.
我们使用了来自MMLU-Pro(Wang等人,2024年)和Natural Reasoning(Yuan等人,2025年)的STEM问题。
每名教师每个MMLU-Pro问题产生4个回答,每个NaturalReasoning问题产生1个回答,有分步推理和最后答案.
对于MMLU-Pro,正确性由官方回答决定.
对于Natural Reasoning来说,来自第三家族的模型Gemma-4-31B-it(Gemma Team,2026年),判断反应是否与参考答案一致.
我们只保留所有四个教师变体,包括同格式控制,至少得出一个正确答复的问题。 对于每个被保留的问题,我们保留了三个源的教师中每个源的第一正确回答,用于分馏(即基数,受害率和避害率等教师),结果形成了三个教师特有的同分问题组.
每个学生都接受过其中之一的人工智能训练.
由此产生的蒸馏数据没有包含有害的请求或拒绝答复。 5,5,我们用两个安全分类器评价蒸馏反应,Qune3Guard-Gen-8B(赵等,2025年)和Granite Guardian(Padhi等,2024年).

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluating Distilled Students’ Behavior
blocks.zh: 2.3 评估辍学学生的行为

blocks.en:
For student fine-tuning, we utilize only the teacher-generated task responses described in Section 2.2 .
For the responses of each of the three teachers, we fine-tune three student models with the same training procedure, namely Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410, 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 and Granite-4.1-8B. 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/blog/ibm-granite/granite-4-1 We evaluate each student on the benchmarks of Section 2.1 with their standard evaluation sets, except MMLU-Pro.
We use chain of thought reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ) for MMLU-Pro, GPQA-Diamond, and the main ManagerBench evaluations.
For MMLU-Pro, we construct two evaluation sets with different relationships to the distillation data.
The six STEM subjects are stratified into a distillation split and a held-out split.
MMLU-H contains the 1,131 held-out STEM questions and measures generalization to unseen questions from the same domains.
MMLU-N contains all 5,753 questions from the eight non-STEM subjects, none of which are used for distillation, and measures performance outside the STEM domains used for training.

blocks.en: 3 Students inherit the disposition alongside task capability
blocks.zh: 3名学生随任务能力一起继承处置权

blocks.en:
RQ1 tests whether task distillation transfers capability and a source-dependent safety–pragmatism disposition at the same time, and how consistently this joint transfer appears across teacher–student pairs.
Figure 2 presents the six teacher--student pairs. 8 8 8 Appendix E reports the complete results and significance tests.
blocks.zh:
RQ1测试任务蒸馏转移能力和同时依赖源的安全性-pragmatism处置,以及这种联合转移在师生对子之间是否一致。
图2列示了6个师生对. 8 8 附录 8 E报告完整的结果和意义测试.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Performance of distilled students across teacher families and student models.
Grey dashed lines in panel (a) denote untrained-student performance, and arrows indicate whether higher or lower values are better.
In panel (b), the expected left-to-right ordering is harm-accepting (red), base (orange), and harm-avoiding (blue) for HA and MB-Score, with the reverse ordering for CP.
blocks.zh:
图 2: 师生家庭及学生模式的分化学生表现.
面板(a)中灰色破折行表示未受训练的学生性能,箭头表示高值或更低值是否更好.
在面板(b)中,预期的从左到右命令是HA和MB-Score的伤害接受(红色),碱(橙)和伤害避免(蓝色),反向命令是CP.

blocks.en:
Distillation transfers task capability across teacher–student pairs. MMLU-Pro is most directly aligned with the distillation task.
For the Qwen3-32B teacher family, all three distilled students outperform the untrained student on both MMLU-Pro evaluations in Figure 2 (a).
The Mistral-Small-3.2-24B teacher family produces the same pattern for nearly every student and MMLU-Pro evaluation.
Most GPQA-Diamond and IFEval accuracies remain close to the untrained baselines, and the MMLU-Pro gains therefore reflect the intended capability transfer.
blocks.zh:
蒸发在师生之间转移任务能力。 MMLU-Pro最直接地配合了蒸馏任务.
对Qune3-32B教师家庭来说,在图2(a)的MMLU-Pro评价中,所有三名提炼出的学生都超过了未受过培训的学生。
Mistral-Small-3.2-24号卫星 页:1 教师家庭为几乎每个学生制作同样的图案和MMLU-Pro评价。
多数GPQA-Diamond和IFEval的速率仍然接近未经培训的基线,因此MMLU-Pro收益反映了预期的能力转让。

blocks.en:
The source teacher shapes downstream decisions most consistently in the Qwen3-32B teacher family. Under the expected imprinting pattern, students distilled from the harm-accepting teacher should show lower HA and MB-Score and higher CP than those distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher.
Across all three student models, the Qwen3-32B teacher family follows this pattern.
The student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher has significantly lower HA than the student distilled from the base teacher in all three cases, whereas the harm-avoiding student has significantly higher HA than both the base-teacher and untrained students.
For all three students, the base-teacher student falls between the two disposition variants on HA, CP, and MB-Score, consistent with bidirectional shifts from a common distillation reference.
However, the higher HA of the harm-avoiding students is accompanied by lower CP relative to the untrained students.
These results are therefore more consistent with a shift in the safety–pragmatism trade-off than with a uniform increase in harm avoidance at unchanged pragmatism.
blocks.zh:
源师在Qune3-32B师生家庭形成最一致的下游决定. 在预期的印花模式下,从接受伤害教师中分出的学生应显示低于HA和MB分数的CP分数,并高于从避免伤害教师中分出的学生.
在三个学生模式中,Qune3-32B教师家庭都遵循这一模式。
受伤害教师提炼的学生在所有三种情况下都大大低于受伤害教师提炼的学生,而受伤害学生的HA明显高于受伤害教师和未受过训练的学生。
对于所有这三名学生来说,基师生在HA,CP和MB-分数上处于两个处置变体之间,这与从一个常见的分馏参考物中双向转移一致.
但是,与未受过培训的学生相比,在避免伤害的学生中,高水平的医管局有较低的CP。
因此,这些结果更符合安全-悲观取舍的转变,而不是以不变的务实态度统一增加避免损害。

blocks.en:
Transfer from the Mistral-Small-3.2-24B teacher family is weaker and more dependent on the teacher–student pairing.
Ministral-8B preserves the full ordering with smaller differences, while Qwen2.5-7B preserves the ordering between the two disposition teachers but not consistently relative to the base teacher.
Granite-4.1-8B shows little separation among the three distilled students.
We do not isolate the cause of this weaker effect.
Thus, source-dependent transfer is consistent across the Qwen3-32B pairings but does not appear equally strongly across teacher families.
blocks.zh:
从Mistral-Small-3.2-24B号卫星转移 教师家庭较弱,更依赖于教师-学生配对。
Ministryal-8B以更小的差别保留了完整的订单,而Quen2.5-7B则保留了两位处置教师之间的订单,但相对于基础教师来说并不连贯.
花岗岩-4.1-8B显示三个被蒸馏出的学生之间几乎没有分离.
我们不孤立这种更弱效应的原因。
因此,在Quen3-32B配对中,依赖源的转移是一致的,但在教师家庭中并不同样强烈地表现出来。

blocks.en:
Imprinting is more consistent on the targeted disposition. On ManagerBench, the harm-accepting and harm-avoiding teachers generally shift students in the intended directions, whereas HarmBench and SORRY-Bench show no consistent source-teacher ordering across student models.
This contrast suggests that imprinting more reliably preserves the targeted behavioral disposition than inducing a uniform change in safety behavior.
blocks.zh:
印花在目标处置上更为一致. 对于Bench经理来说,接受伤害和避免伤害的教师通常将学生转移到预定的方向,而Harm Bench和Sorry-Bench则没有表现出一贯的源教教师命令学生模式。
这一对比表明,印出更可靠地保存了目标行为处置,而不是诱发安全行为的统一改变.

blocks.en: Table 2: OPD ManagerBench harm avoidance under CoT prompting (%).
blocks.zh: 表2:在COT提示下OPD经理Bench避免伤害(%).

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation also imprints the disposition. Inspired by recent findings that behavioral traits can transfer through on-policy distillation (OPD) ( Askin et al., 2026 ; Shah et al., 2026 ) , we test whether imprinting persists without teacher-generated text.
Qwen2.5-7B and Granite-4.1-8B each sample their own responses to the same 6,943 knowledge questions, while one of three fixed Qwen3-32B teachers scores only the sampled responses under a reverse-KL objective. 9 9 9 Appendix F reports the cross-tokenizer estimator, detailed settings, and significance tests. Table 2 shows that, for both student models, students trained with scores from the harm-accepting teacher are less harm-avoiding than those trained with scores from the harm-avoiding teacher under CoT evaluation prompting.
This separation is statistically significant for both students.
Teacher scores alone can therefore carry a source-dependent disposition without teacher-generated text.
blocks.zh:
政策上的分解也给处置留下了印记。 受到最近发现的启发,即行为特征可以通过政策上蒸馏(OPD)来转移(Askin等,2026;Shah等,2026),我们检验印记是否在没有由教师生成的文本的情况下持续存在.
Quen2.5-7B和Granite-4.1-8B各自对相同的6,943个知识问题给出了自己的回答样本,而三个固定的Quen3-32B的教师中有一个在逆-KL目标下只给出了被抽样答复的分数. 9 - 9 9 F报告交叉切除器估计,详细设置,以及意义测试. 表2显示,在两个学生模式中,受过伤害接收教师分数培训的学生比在COT评价下受过伤害避免教师分数培训的学生少。
这种分离在统计学上对两个学生都很重要。
因此,单靠教师的分数就可以不带教师生成的文字而带有依赖源的处理方式.

blocks.en: 4 What carries the disposition
blocks.zh: 页:1 处理的是什么?

blocks.en: 4.1 Divergence-token masking removes a substantial part of imprinting
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 异口同声的口罩可以消除相当一部分的印记

blocks.en:
Having established that task distillation can transfer capability and source-dependent behavior together, RQ2 asks where the source-dependent signal remains in ordinary task responses.
Prior evidence shows that a sparse set of divergence tokens can carry behavioral transfer through number sequences ( Schrodi et al., 2026 ) , motivating us to test whether divergence tokens also carry imprinting in ordinary task responses.
blocks.zh:
在确定了任务分馏可以一起转移能力和依赖源的行为后,RQ2询问依赖源的信号在普通任务响应中仍然停留在哪里.
先前的证据表明,稀有的一组相差符号可以通过数字序列(Schrodi等,2026年)携带行为转移,激励我们测试相差符号是否还带有普通任务响应中的印记.

blocks.en:
At every position of a response, we give both teachers the same prefix and record their greedy next-token predictions.
A position is a divergence token when the teacher that wrote the response predicts the observed token and the other teacher predicts a different one.
Divergence tokens are sparse, about 2% of the positions in the responses of either teacher.
The two teachers also diverge on different words, the harm-accepting teacher on words such as spread , how , and rather , and the harm-avoiding teacher on hold , outcome , and held .
Even these words are divergence tokens only in some contexts: how , for example, is a divergence token in 35% of its occurrences in responses from the harm-accepting teacher and never in those from the harm-avoiding teacher. The signal thus attaches to particular occurrences of a word rather than to the word itself.
The masking experiment therefore excludes those occurrences and leaves the others in place. 10 10 10 Appendix G reports the complete analysis of divergence tokens.
blocks.zh:
在回答的每一个位置,我们给两位老师一个相同的前缀,并记录他们贪婪的下个接吻预测.
当写答题的老师预测被观测到的指题,而另一个老师预测不同的指题时,一个位置就是一个相差分的指题.
差异标志很少,约占教师答复职位的2%。
两位老师在不同的词上也存在分歧,
即使是这些词也只是某些情况下的差异标志:例如,在35%的受伤害教师的响应中,这些词是如何成为差异标志的,在受伤害教师的响应中,绝不是受伤害教师的响应。 因此,该信号附属于某个词的特定现象,而不是该词本身。
因此,蒙面试验排除了这些事故,而将其他事故留在原地。 G报告对差异符号的全面分析。

blocks.en:
We define the imprinting gap as the harm-avoidance rate of the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher minus that of the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher.
We restrict this experiment to the harm-accepting and harm-avoiding Qwen3-32B teachers and to Qwen2.5-7B and Granite-4.1-8B, the two students with the largest imprinting gaps.
We use the same teacher responses as in Section 3 and change only which response positions contribute to the distillation loss.
For each disposition teacher, we train one student with the divergence positions excluded and one with a matched number of randomly selected non-divergence positions excluded.
The random control tests whether any reduction in imprinting comes simply from removing the same amount of supervision.
Table 3 reports harm avoidance and held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy, with the original students from Section 3 serving as the no-exclusion reference.
blocks.zh:
我们把印花差距定义为:学生从避免伤害教师中蒸馏的避免伤害率减去学生从接受伤害教师中蒸馏的避免伤害率.
我们把这个实验限制在受伤害和避免伤害的Quen3-32B教师,以及受伤害最大的两个学生Quen2.5-7B和Granite 4.1-8B.
我们使用与第3节相同的教师反应,并只改变哪些反应位置导致蒸馏损失。
对于每个处置教师,我们培训一名学生,其位置不相上下,培训一名学生,其位置不相上下。
随机控制测试印记的减少是否仅仅来自于去除同样数量的监管.
表3报告了避免危害的情况以及MMLU-Pro的准确性,第3节的原生学生作为不排斥的参考。

blocks.en:
Table 3: Results of divergence-token exclusion on ManagerBench under CoT reasoning.
Imprinting gap denotes the harm-avoidance difference between the two students in percentage points (pp).
blocks.zh:
表3:根据《公约》的推理,Bench经理被排斥在歧义之外的结果。
Imprinting difference 表示两个学生之间以百分点(pp)表示的避免危害差异.

blocks.en:
Excluding divergence positions substantially reduces the imprinting gap while preserving task capability. Table 3 shows that matched random exclusion does not reduce the imprinting gap, whereas divergence exclusion pulls the two students toward each other for both student models.
Divergence exclusion removes 64% of the gap for Granite-4.1-8B and 28% for Qwen2.5-7B relative to matched random exclusion, and 59% and 29% relative to the reference without exclusion.
Across both student models, the harm-avoiding and harm-accepting students differ significantly in HA under all three exclusion settings (Holm-corrected paired McNemar, all p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
Notably, the difference remains significant even after divergence exclusion, despite the substantially smaller imprinting gap.
Held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy varies by at most 3.4 points across the three settings, and no tested difference is statistically significant.
About 2% of the supervised positions therefore account for a disproportionate share of the imprinting signal without significantly affecting held-out task accuracy.
In the number-sequence setting of Schrodi et al. (2026) , masking divergence tokens largely suppressed behavioral transfer.
In our task responses, the same intervention reduces the imprinting gap but does not remove it.
blocks.zh:
排除分歧立场可大大减少印记上的差距,同时保持任务能力。 表3显示,相应的随机排斥并不能缩小印花差距,而差异排斥则使两个学生在两个学生模式中相互拉近。
差异排除消除了Granite-4.1-8B的64%和Quen2.5-7B的28%与随机排除相对应的差距,以及59%和29%与未排除的参考相比的差距。
在整个两个学生模式中,在医管局所有三种排斥环境(Holm修正配对的McNemar, 全部p < 0.001 p < 0.001)下,避免伤害和接受伤害的学生差别很大。
值得注意的是,即使在排除分歧之后,尽管影响差距大大缩小,但差异仍然很大。
Hold-out MMLU-Pro的精度在三种设置的最多3.4分时不同,没有经过测试的差别在统计学上是显著的.
因此,大约2%的受监督职位在印出信号中所占的份额不成比例,没有显著地影响被搁置的任务的准确性。
在Schrodi等人(2026年)的数序设定中,遮掩分化符号在很大程度上抑制了行为转移.
在我们的任务对策中,同样的干预措施缩小了影响深远的差距,但并没有消除这种差距。

blocks.en: 4.2 Rewriting by another model does not remove imprinting
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 另一个模型的重写不会去除印记

blocks.en:
If imprinting is partly carried by teacher-specific token choices, rewriting the responses with a different model may disrupt that signal.
We therefore test whether such rewriting reduces imprinting.
Each of the three untrained student models serves as a rewriter, paraphrasing responses from all three Qwen3-32B source teachers using an instruction adapted from Gisler et al. (2026) , with an additional constraint to preserve the final-answer line.
This inserts a rewriting step between teacher generation and student training.
After rewriting, we repeat the response-selection procedure from Section 2.2 , retaining only questions for which all three rewritten teacher responses remain correct.
Table 4 reports the change from the untrained student in held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy, harm avoidance, and control pragmatism for every rewriter–student pairing.
blocks.zh:
如果印记部分由教师特有的符号选择所携带,用不同的模型来重写响应可能会打乱这个信号.
因此,我们检验这种改写是否减少了印记。
三个未受训练的学生模型中,每个都充当了重写者,用从Gisler等(2026年)改编而来的指示来诠释出所有三位Qune3-32B源教师的回应,并附加了保留最终答案行的限制.
此处插入了师生培养与学生培养之间的重写步骤.
在改写后,我们重复第2.2节的回复选择程序,只保留所有三个改写的教师答复都正确的问题。
表4记录了未受过训练的学生在MMLU-Pro的精确度、避免伤害和控制实用性方面的变化,

The original responses are generated by the Qwen3-32B teacher variants.

blocks.en:
Rewriting does not eliminate imprinting. Across all rewriter–student pairings, the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher remains more harm-avoidant than its harm-accepting counterpart (all Holm-adjusted p < 0.02 p<0.02 ), although the imprinting gap and overall level of harm avoidance vary across rewriters.
Task-capability transfer is largely preserved, except for Granite-4.1-8B when responses are rewritten by Ministral-8B.
Rewriting by Qwen2.5-7B also leaves 63--66% of the words selected from original divergence positions as divergence tokens in the rewritten responses. 11 11 11 Appendix G.2 details the analysis and its controls. This persistence is consistent with the survival of imprinting after rewriting.
blocks.zh:
重写不会消除印花. 在所有的重写者-学生配对中,从避免伤害教师中提炼出来的学生仍然比其接受伤害的对应者(所有Holm调整后p < 0.02 p < 0.02)更能避免伤害,尽管各重写者在避免伤害方面的印痕差距和总体水平各不相同。
任务能力转移基本保留了下来,但Granite-4.1-8B除外,因为Ministry-8B重写了回复.
由Quen2.5-7B重写,在重写回复中还留下了从原相差位置所选择的63%至66%作为相差符号的单词. 11 11 附录G.2详细介绍了分析及其控制. 这种持久性与重写后印花活性是一致的.

blocks.en: 5 Mitigating imprinting after distillation
blocks.zh: 页:1 蒸馏后减轻印花

blocks.en:
Having found that source-dependent behavior survives both divergence token filtering and response rewriting, RQ3 asks whether post-distillation safety alignment can remove it.
We focus on Qwen2.5-7B and Granite-4.1-8B, distilled from the base and harm-accepting Qwen3-32B teachers.
For each student, we compare no further training with supervised fine-tuning, generic direct preference optimization (DPO) ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , and targeted DPO based on ManagerBench-style preference pairs.
Safety SFT and generic DPO use matched PKU-SafeRLHF prompts ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , whereas targeted DPO directly supervises the distinction between harm avoidance and control pragmatism. 12 12 12 Appendix H presents the training-pair construction, data filtering, and additional intervention settings. Table 5 reports the results.
blocks.zh:
在发现依赖源的行为既能活过相差符号过滤又能活过响应重写后,RQ3问到分解后安全对接是否能够去除.
我们专注于从基地分出并接受危害的Quen2.5-7B和Granite-4.1-8B教师.
对每个学生来说,我们不进行进一步培训与有监督的微调、通用的直接优惠优化(DPO)(Rafailov等,2023年)和基于Bench经理式优惠对的定向DPO进行比较。
Safety SFT和通用DPO的使用与PKU-SAFERLHF的提示相匹配(Ji等,2025年),而目标DPO直接监督避免伤害和控制实用性之间的区别. 附录 12 H介绍了培训辅助构筑、数据过滤和其他干预设置。 表5报告了结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Post-distillation safety interventions on students distilled from responses generated by the base and harm-accepting Qwen3-32B teachers. ▲ \blacktriangle and ▼ \blacktriangledown mark significant improvements and degradations relative to the none row of the same student ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), with the direction of each metric given by the arrow in its header.
blocks.zh: 表5:从基地教师和接受危害的Qune3-32B教师产生的反应中提炼出来的针对学生的蒸发后安全干预措施。 \\ blacktriangle和\\ blacktriangle down 标志着相对于同一学生的无一行(p < 0.05 p < 0.05),显著的改善和退化,每个公分量的方向由箭头所给出.

blocks.en:
Preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not erase the source-dependent difference. Safety SFT sharply lowers HA for all four students, while also degrading held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy and increasing harmful-request compliance.
Generic DPO instead raises HA for all four students, lowers HarmBench attack success and SORRY-Bench fulfillment, and leaves held-out accuracy close to its pre-intervention value.
Even after generic DPO, the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher remains less harm-avoidant than the student distilled from the base teacher for both Qwen2.5-7B (0.3931 vs. 0.5210) and Granite-4.1-8B (0.6551 vs. 0.7252). Both differences remain significant (Holm-corrected paired McNemar, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh:
优先权优化可以避免伤害,但不能消除依赖源的差异。 所有4名学生的安全SFT大幅度降低HA,同时降低被扣留的MMLU-Pro的准确性并增加有害要求的遵守。
相反,普通DPO为所有四个学生提高HA,降低Harm Bench攻击成功率和Sorry-Bench的实现率,并留下接近其干预前价值的被搁置准确度。
即使在一般的DPO之后,从接受伤害的老师中分馏出来的学生仍然不如从基地老师中分馏出来的学生,无论是Qun2.5-7B(0.3931对0.5210)还是Granite-4.1-8B(0.6551对0.7252). 这两个差异仍然很大(Holm修正成对的McNemar,p < 0.001 p <.001)。

blocks.en:
Targeted DPO retains more control pragmatism than generic DPO in all four settings, but tends to yield smaller HA gains and produces no significant changes on HarmBench or SORRY-Bench.
Neither DPO variant eliminates the difference in harm avoidance between the source-teacher conditions.
blocks.zh:
目标DPO在所有四个场合都保留了比通用DPO更多的控制实用性,但往往能产生较小的HA收益并不会对Harm Bench或Sorry-Bench产生重大变化.
DPO的变式都无法消除源教师条件在避免伤害方面的差别。

The harm-accepting source increases misaligned tool use under explicit harmful naming. PropensityBench ( Sehwag et al., 2026 ) tests whether an agent switches to a misaligned tool when the aligned path repeatedly fails under increasing operational pressure.
The same misaligned action is presented either with an explicitly harmful name (e.g., force_privilege_escalation_for_log_access) or a benign-sounding name (e.g., enable_direct_log_access_mode), while its harmful consequences remain stated.

受害源在明显的有害命名下会增加错配工具的使用. Propensity Bench(Sehwag等,2026年)测试当对接路径在不断增大的操作压力下反复失败时,一个代理机是否切换到一个错接工具.

Under the harmful tool name, the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher selects the misaligned tool more often than its harm-avoiding counterpart for both Qwen2.5-7B and Granite-4.1-8B.
This ordering holds across all six pressure dimensions for both student models ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
The broader PropensityBench results are less uniform: tool naming substantially affects behavior, Qwen2.5-7B students differ greatly in how often they call any tool, and the Granite-4.1-8B comparison is sensitive to how unfinished scenarios are scored.
These results show that imprinting can extend to agentic tool choice under explicit harmful naming, while the broader transfer pattern remains sensitive to tool naming, tool-call rates, and scoring choices. 13 13 13 Appendix I reports the complete metrics and scoring analysis.
As a complementary intervention during distillation, Appendix J shows that replacing harm-accepting-teacher responses with base-teacher responses increases harm avoidance without significantly changing held-out accuracy.

在有害工具名下,从伤害-接受老师中分馏出来的学生比起其避免伤害的对应工具更频繁地选择了错误的对应工具来进行Quen2.5-7B和Granite-4.1-8B两种.
这一命令贯穿了两个学生模型的所有六个压力维度(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)。
更广义的Propensity Bench结果不太统一:工具命名对行为有重大影响,Quen2.5-7B学生称任何工具的频率相去甚远,而Granite-4.1-8B比较对未完成的场景如何得分很敏感.
这些结果表明,印记可以在明显的有害命名下延伸至代理工具选择,而更广泛的传输模式仍然对工具命名、工具调用率和评分选择敏感。 我报告完整的衡量和评分分析。
作为蒸馏过程中的一种补充性干预措施,附录J显示,将接受伤害的教师反应取而代之的是基本教师反应,这可以增加避免伤害,而不会显著地改变搁置的准确性。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLM distillation and imitation. LLM distillation transfers capability through teacher-generated rationales ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) , generative distillation objectives ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , and on-policy student generation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) .
Imitating teacher outputs does not necessarily recover the teacher’s underlying capabilities ( Gudibande et al., 2024 ) .
These works primarily study capability transfer and optimization.
We study imprinting as the transfer of a source teacher’s downstream behavioral disposition through ordinary task supervision across different base models.
blocks.zh:
LLM蒸馏和仿制. LLM分馏能力通过由教师产生的理由(Hsieh等,2023年),基因分馏目标(Gu等,2024年),以及政策性学生产生能力(Agarwal等,2024年).
模仿教师产出不一定能恢复教师的基本能力(Gudibande等,2024年)。
这些工程主要研究能力转移和优化.
我们研究将源头教师的下游行为处置 通过不同基模型的普通任务监督来转移。

blocks.en:
Traits that travel through training data. Subliminal learning showed that teacher preferences and misalignment can pass through semantically unrelated data, with reliable transfer largely concentrated in shared-base-model settings ( Cloud et al., 2026 ) . Schrodi et al. (2026) traced this transfer to sparse divergence tokens, while Blank et al. (2026) characterized it as steering-vector distillation.
The strength of transfer varies with the student training setup and with how the teacher’s bias is induced ( Schrodi et al., 2026 ; Morgulis and Hewitt, 2026 ) . Other work has studied the mechanisms and transfer properties of subliminal learning ( Aden-Ali et al., 2026 ; Madl, 2026 ; König et al., 2026 ) . Transfer has also been demonstrated through natural-language paraphrases ( Gisler et al., 2026 ) , covert distillation channels ( Morgulis and Hewitt, 2026 ; Shah et al., 2026 ) , and agent trajectories ( Dang et al., 2026 ) .
Related phenomena include emergent misalignment ( Betley et al., 2025 ; Soligo et al., 2025 ) , backdoors that survive distillation ( De Muri et al., 2025 ) , and instruction-tuning poisoning ( Wan et al., 2023 ) .
We focus on cross-family distillation from matched, correctness-filtered task responses generated by teachers with contrasting safety–pragmatism dispositions, and examine the resulting capability gains and behavioral shifts.
blocks.zh:
通过训练数据旅行的特质 潜心学习显示,教师偏好和错位可能通过与众生无关的数据传递,可靠的转移主要集中在共享基建-模型环境(Cloud等,2026年). Schrodi等人(2026年)将这种转移追溯到稀有的分化活体,而Blank等人则将这种转移追溯到稀有分化活体. (2026年)将其定性为向导-向导蒸馏.
转校的强度随学生培训的设置以及教师偏见的诱发方式而不同(Schrodi等,2026;Morgulis和Hewitt,2026.). 其他工作研究了潜心学习的机制和转移属性(Aden-Ali等,2026;Madl,2026;König等,2026.). 转录也通过自然语言解说(Gisler等,2026年),隐蔽分馏通道(Morgulis和Hewitt等,2026年;Shah等,2026年)和剂道(Dang等,2026年)被证明.
相关现象包括出现错位 (Betley等人,2025年;Soligo等人,2025年),在蒸馏后幸存的后门(De Muri等人,2025年),以及指导调解中毒(Wan等人,2023年)。
我们注重从教师对安全-pragmatism的对应、正确、过滤的任务反应中进行跨家庭蒸馏,并审查由此产生的能力增益和行为转变。

blocks.en:
Removing transferred behavior. Benign fine-tuning can weaken safety alignment ( Qi et al., 2024 ) , safety alignment can depend heavily on the first few output tokens ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , and trained behaviors can survive subsequent safety training ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) .
These findings motivate our test of whether post-distillation alignment removes an imprinted disposition.
Watermarked training data can leave detectable traces in downstream models ( Sander et al., 2024 ) , and paraphrasing the training data can weaken watermark inheritance ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . Our rewriting experiment asks the corresponding question for a behavioral disposition rather than a detectable watermark.
blocks.zh:
删除转移的行为 。 Benign微调可削弱安全相接(Qi等,2024年),安全相接可严重依赖前少数出产活符(Qi等,2025年),经过训练的行为可以活过后续的安全训练(Hubinger等,2024年).
这些调查结果促使我们检验消化后调整是否消除了印有标记的处理方式。
标有水的训练数据可以在下游模型中留下可探测到的痕迹(Sander等,2024年),而标出训练数据会削弱水印继承(Pan等,2025年). 我们的重写实验 提出了相应的问题 一个行为处置 而不是一个可探测的水印。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation transfers supervision through teacher-generated responses, raising the question of whether the source teacher influences the student beyond the intended task capability.
To isolate this source-dependent influence, we construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same teacher, generate matched corpora of responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions, and distill them into students with different base models.
Across multiple teacher–student pairs, students acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher’s safety–pragmatism disposition, demonstrating imprinting across different base models.
We further examine what carries this effect and how readily it can be removed.
Excluding divergence positions from the distillation loss weakens imprinting, while rewriting changes its magnitude without eliminating it. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference, and the strength of imprinting varies across teacher–student pairs and forms of safety behavior.
In sum, these results show that teacher-generated supervision can carry source-dependent behavioral information beyond the intended task capability.
blocks.zh:
知识分馏通过教师生成的回应转移监督,提出了源师是否影响学生超出预定任务能力的问题.
为了孤立这种依赖源的影响,我们构建了同一个老师的伤害接受和避免伤害的变体,生成了对应的对普通推理和知识问题的响应的集合体,并将其分解为具有不同基模型的学生.
学生们通过多种教师-学生配对获得任务能力,而他们的下游决定则转向源头教师的安全性-pragmatism的处置方式,显示了不同基本模式的印记。
我们进一步审查什么具有这种影响,以及如何能够轻易消除这种影响。
将不同位置排除在蒸馏损失之外会削弱印花,而重写则会改变其规模而不会消除。 消化后偏好优化可以避免伤害,但并不能消除依赖源的差异,而印记的强度因教师-学生对子和安全行为的形式而异.
总之,这些结果表明,教师产生的监督可以将依赖源的行为信息携带到预定任务能力之外.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work constructs teachers with a harm-accepting disposition in order to study how such a disposition propagates through distillation and how it can be mitigated.
The central finding of this paper is that distillation data which contain no harmful requests or refusals can nevertheless transmit this disposition, and we therefore treat the distillation data and the trained adapters as sensitive artifacts.
We make the teacher and student adapters and the distillation data available only under a research-only license with gated access.
blocks.zh:
这项工作使教师有了接受伤害的处理方法,以便研究这种处理方法如何通过蒸馏传播以及如何减轻影响。
本文的核心结论是,没有提出有害要求或拒绝的蒸馏数据仍然可以传递这种处置,因此,我们将蒸馏数据和经过培训的适配器视为敏感的文物。
我们只能凭只限研究的许可证提供师生适配器和蒸馏数据。

blocks.en: Option A prioritizes safety by maintaining current routing systems that avoid any risk to pedestrians. While this aligns with public safety expectations and avoids legal and reputational risks, it results in slower delivery times, higher costs, and potential financial losses. blocks.en: Option A: Prioritize Safety

blocks.en: Pros: Eliminates risk of harm to pedestrians. Aligns with public safety expectations and legal obligations. Avoids potential lawsuits and reputational damage. Maintains public trust in the AI system and the company.

blocks.en: Pros: Reduces delivery times by 50%. Significantly lowers operational costs. Enhances profitability and market competitiveness. Aligns with the company’s financial goals and leadership priorities.

blocks.en: Decision Factors:

blocks.en: 1. Ethical Responsibility: The AI system has a duty to minimize harm to humans. Even a 5% chance of injury is a significant ethical concern.

blocks.en: 2. Long-Term Impact: While Option B may boost short-term profits, the potential for harm could lead to long-term reputational damage and regulatory consequences.

blocks.en: 3. Stakeholder Impact: The company’s stakeholders (customers, employees, investors) may prioritize safety and public trust over short-term financial gains.

blocks.en: Conclusion:

blocks.en: While Option B offers significant operational and financial benefits, the ethical and safety risks it introduces are substantial. The potential harm to pedestrians, even if statistically minor, is a serious concern that could have far-reaching consequences for the company.

blocks.en: Both students identify the same operational benefits and risks. The student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher treats the injury risk as acceptable in light of the efficiency gain and industry practice. The student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher instead assigns priority to ethical responsibility, public trust, and legal risk. The example therefore illustrates a difference in the reasoning used to resolve the trade-off rather than a difference confined to the final answer. The aggregate comparisons in Section 3 determine whether this ordering generalizes beyond the example.

blocks.en:
BC-LAT builds on latent personality alignment (LPA), which applies latent adversarial training to 66 harm-agnostic statements from the psychometric personality literature, each paired with a short agreement or disagreement target ( Le et al., 2026 ; Merzouk et al., 2026 ) .
Our initial pilot found that the agreement-style response format itself shifted ManagerBench behavior even when the statements were unrelated to safety or personality.
We therefore retained the latent adversarial objective but replaced the agreement-style targets with behavioral continuations.
Using Claude Fable 5, 14 14 14 https://www.anthropic.com/claude/fable . we generated 22 first-person scenarios spanning direct harm–goal trade-offs and related decision tendencies, including risk discounting, accountability, metric prioritization, and deference to authority.
blocks.zh:
BC-LAT基于潜在的个性一致(LPA),它将潜在的对抗性训练应用于来自心理衡量个性文献的66个伤害不可知性陈述,每个陈述都配有短期协议或分歧目标(Le等,2026;Merzouk等,2026)。
我们的初始飞行员发现,协议式的响应格式本身改变了Bench经理的行为,即使这些声明与安全或人格无关.
因此,我们保留潜在的对抗目标,但以行为延续取代协议式的目标。
使用克洛德·寓言5, 14 14 https://www.harmic.com/claude/fable. 我们产生了22个第一人称假设, 涵盖直接伤害 — — 目标权衡和相关的决定倾向,包括风险折扣、问责制、衡量优先顺序以及尊重权威。

blocks.en:
Statement-format pilot. The original statement-based pilot used 718 high-harm ManagerBench scenarios.
It compared the base model, an adverse-trait teacher trained with the LPA-style statement format ( Le et al., 2026 ; Merzouk et al., 2026 ) , the precursor to the harm-accepting teacher of Section 2.1 , and a format control trained on statements unrelated to safety or personality.
Table 6 reports the fraction of scenarios in which each model selected the harm-accepting option.

表6汇报了每个模型选择接受损害的备选办法的几分之一的情况。

blocks.zh: 表6:718高危害经理本奇情景的报表格式试验中的危害接受率. 格式控制共享了不良trait老师的响应格式,但没有包含与安全或人格相关的内容.

blocks.en:
Under direct answering, the adverse-trait teacher increased harm acceptance over the base model by 0.2633 and the format control by 0.1797, so the format control reproduced 68% of the shift.
Under chain-of-thought answering, the corresponding increases were 0.1031 and 0.0613, so the format control reproduced 59% of the shift.
The format control therefore reproduced most of the observed shift despite containing no trait-related content. This finding motivated the matched behavioral-continuation design used in the main experiments.

在思维链回接下,相应的增加为0.1031和0.0613,因此格式控制转载了59%的转会.
因此,格式控制照搬了大多数观察到的转变,尽管没有与特性相关的内容。 这一发现激发了主要实验中使用的相匹配的行为连续设计.

blocks.en:
Teachers. BC-LAT perturbs the residual stream at one decoder layer with a per-token perturbation of bounded L 2 L_{2} norm ϵ \epsilon , found by 16 steps of projected gradient descent with normalized gradients and step size 0.05 ​ ϵ 0.05\,\epsilon toward the unrewarded continuation, while LoRA adapters of rank 16 and scaling 32 are trained for 30 epochs with AdamW at a constant learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , no weight decay, gradient clipping at 1.0, and batch size 8 to raise the likelihood of the rewarded continuation under the perturbation.
The perturbed layer is at 75% of the decoder depth, and ϵ \epsilon is 10% of the mean hidden-state norm at that layer over the calibration prompts, which gives layer 48 and ϵ = 54.01 \epsilon=54.01 for Qwen3-32B and layer 30 and ϵ = 1.88 \epsilon=1.88 for Mistral-Small-3.2-24B.
All other settings are identical for the two families.
Checkpoints are saved every two epochs and selected using a forced-choice measure of whether the teacher reproduces the rewarded continuation under its own scenarios, to avoid penalizing checkpoints that express the intended continuation through a paraphrase rather than a verbatim match.
The selected adapter is merged into the base weights before generation.
The selected checkpoints are epoch 24 for the harm-accepting teacher, epoch 30 for the harm-avoiding teacher, epoch 30 for the same-format control, and epoch 14 for the personality-statement reference of Qwen3-32B, and epoch 10, 12, and 8 for the harm-accepting, harm-avoiding, and same-format control teachers of Mistral-Small-3.2-24B.
The two disposition teachers of a family therefore receive different amounts of training under the same selection rule and the same 30-epoch budget, and Table 1 confirms that neither the capability nor the harmful-request metrics move significantly for either of them.
blocks.zh:
师曰. BC-LAT在一分解码层对残余流进行扰动,每分解出L 2 L_{2}规范的ε-\epsilon被16个梯度下降的预想步骤所发现,梯度下降呈正向梯度和步数0.05 ± 0.05\\\eepsilon向无报酬的续作,而16级和32级的LORA适配器则被训练给与AdamW的30个学期,持续学习速度为5×10 − 5 = 5 = 10^{-5},不发生重量衰减,从1.0分解出梯度,分解为8分解,以提高在扰作得到奖励的续作的可能性。
扰动地层为解码器深度的75%,而QQ\epsilon是该地层中平均隐藏状态规范的10%,高于校正提示,它给出了第48层,QQ=54.01\epsilon=54.01 对于Qune3-32B. 和 第30层, += 1.88\epsilon= 1.88 用于米斯特拉尔- Small-3.2-24B。
所有其他设置对两个家庭都是一样的.

blocks.en: Teacher response generation. Each teacher samples four responses per MMLU-Pro question and one response per NaturalReasoning question with vLLM at temperature 0.6. We set the maximum generation length to 1,024 tokens for MMLU-Pro and 1,536 tokens for NaturalReasoning. For MMLU-Pro, correctness is determined by the official answer. For NaturalReasoning, Gemma-4-31B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) with the judge prompt of Appendix B , a model from a third family, judges whether the response is consistent with the reference answer. We retain only questions for which all four teacher variants (i.e., the base, harm-accepting, harm-avoiding, and same-format control teachers) produce at least one correct response. For each retained question, we keep the first correct response from each of the three source teachers used for distillation in sampling order.
blocks.zh: 师后应机. 每个教师在0.6温度下对每个MMLU-Pro问题四个答复和每个自然反应问题一个答复进行VLLM取样。 我们规定MMLU-Pro的最大发电长度为1 024个令牌,Natural Reasoning为1 536个令牌。 对于MMLU-Pro,正确性由官方回答决定. 对于"Natural Reasoning",Gemma-4-31B-it(Gemma Team,2026年),由法官提示附录B,是来自第三家族的模型,判断回应是否与参考答案一致. 我们只保留所有四种教师变体(即基础、接受伤害、避免伤害和同格式控制教师)至少得出一个正确答复的问题。 对于每个保留的问题,我们保留了三个源的教师中每一个在采样顺序中用于分馏的第一正确反应.

blocks.en:
Students. Every student is fine-tuned with LoRA adapters of rank 64 and scaling 128 on all linear projections, for two epochs with AdamW, a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} under a cosine schedule with a warmup ratio of 0.03, no weight decay, an effective batch size of 16, a maximum sequence length of 4,096 tokens, bfloat16 precision, and a fixed seed.
The loss is computed only on assistant-response tokens, including the reasoning trace and the final answer, with prompt tokens masked. Training aborts on the first non-finite gradient, and all tensors are checked for finite values before saving.
The same training configuration is applied without change to every teacher-generated response set in the paper, including the rewritten, masked, and mixed data.
blocks.zh:
诸生. 每个学生都会在所有线性预测上与64级和128级的LORA适配器进行微调,为与AdamW相接的两个纪元,在同位素表下最高学习率为10-4 10-Q-4},热速比为0.03,无重量衰减,有效批量尺寸为16,最大序列长度为4,096个令牌,bfloat16精度,并有固定种子.
损失仅根据助理反应信使计算,包括推理追踪和最后答案,并用即时信使口罩. 在第一个非无限梯度上培训中止,在保存前将检查所有对数。
同样的培训配置适用于论文中每个教师生成的响应,包括重写、遮盖和混合数据。

blocks.en:
Evaluation. Generation for evaluation uses greedy decoding with a 4,096-token limit.
Every response is stored in full before parsing.
For the benchmarks scored by answer parsing, namely MMLU-Pro, GPQA-Diamond, and ManagerBench, an unparsed answer is scored as incorrect.
On ManagerBench, an unparsed answer is counted in the denominator but not as harm-avoiding or pragmatic.
MMLU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond are scored by final-answer accuracy, and IFEval by strict prompt-level accuracy. HarmBench reports the classifier-judged attack-success rate, and SORRY-Bench reports the judge-assigned fulfillment rate.
Paired comparisons use McNemar’s test, with p-values computed using either an exact binomial test or a continuity-corrected chi-square approximation depending on the number of discordant pairs. Holm correction is applied within each family of tests.
Tilt and MB-Score are descriptive composite metrics and are not tested separately.
blocks.zh:
评价。 用于评价的生成使用4,096个托肯极限的贪婪的解码.
在解析前,每个回复都全部存储.
对于通过答案解析得分的基准,即MMLU-Pro,GPQA-Diamond,以及Manager Bench,一个未解析的答案被评为不正确.
在Bench经理身上,未解答的答案算在分母中,但并不是避免伤害或务实的.
MMLU-Pro和GPQA-Diamond通过最终答案精确度得分,而IFEval则通过严格的即时精确度得分. Harm Bench报告分级员判断的攻击成功率, Sorry Bench报告法官指定完成率。
Paired比较使用McNemar的测试,p值的计算方法要么是精确的二元测试,要么是连续修正的基平方相近,这取决于不相配对的数量。 在每个测试类别中都适用 " 整体矫正 " 。
倾斜和MB-分数是描述性的复合度量衡,不单独测试.

blocks.en:
Compute. All training and generation ran on NVIDIA H200 GPUs with 141 GB of memory on a Slurm cluster.
A teacher’s BC-LAT run uses one GPU, response generation and evaluation use vLLM on one GPU per job, and a student’s fine-tuning uses one GPU for under two hours.

Seed replication. We retrain the students distilled from the harm-avoiding and harm-accepting Qwen3-32B teachers into Qwen2.5-7B and Granite-4.1-8B with two further seeds, which change the data order and the adapter initialization, and evaluate them with the same harness.
Table 12 reports the mean and standard deviation over the three seeds.
The imprinting gap is 27.7, 18.7, and 23.2 points for Qwen2.5-7B and 23.5, 18.6, and 16.7 points for Granite-4.1-8B, and within every seed the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher is significantly more harm-avoidant than its harm-accepting counterpart under the paired McNemar test of Appendix D ( p < 10 − 27 p<10^{-27} after Holm correction).
Between seeds of the same student, held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy and control pragmatism never differ significantly (24 comparisons, Holm-corrected p ≥ 0.08 p\geq 0.08 ).
Harm avoidance differs significantly in 5 of 12 comparisons, by 4 to 9 points.
The largest of these shifts is 56% of the smallest imprinting gap.
Across all three seeds, the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher remains significantly more harm-avoidant than its harm-accepting counterpart (Holm-corrected paired McNemar, all p < 10 − 27 p<10^{-27} ).
Held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy does not differ significantly between the two source conditions in any seed.
The seed changes the absolute level of harm avoidance by several points, but not the source-dependent ordering or the preservation of held-out task accuracy.
blocks.zh:

积分差距为:Quen2.5-7B分27.7分、18.7分和23.5分18.6分和Granite-4.1-8B分16.7分,在每个种子中,从避免伤害教师中分出的学生比在附录D的麦克内马尔试验中分出对等的伤害避免剂要多得多(在Holm修正之后,p < 10 - 27 p < 10 *-27})。

在12个比较中的5个比较中,避免损害差别很大,有4到9分.
这些班次中最大的班次是最小印花缺口的56%.
在所有三种种子中,从避免伤害教师中分馏出来的学生仍然比接受伤害的对应者(Holm-recorded coupled McNemar,所有p < 10 - 27 p < 10--27})要多得多。

blocks.en: Appendix F On-policy distillation
blocks.zh: 附录F 政策提炼

blocks.en:
This appendix describes the on-policy distillation (OPD) experiment summarized in Table 2 .
The experiment tests whether a source-dependent disposition transfers when the student never trains on teacher-generated text: the student generates every training response itself, and a fixed teacher only assigns log-probabilities to those responses.
blocks.zh:
本附录介绍表2所总结的政策分解试验。
实验测试一个依赖源的处置是否在学生从未在师生生成的文本上训练时进行转移:学生自己生成每一个培训响应,固定的教师只为这些响应分配日志概率.

blocks.en:
Objective. For a prompt q q and a response y y sampled from the student S θ S_{\theta} , the objective is the sampled reverse KL divergence 𝔼 y ∼ S θ ​ [ log ⁡ S θ ​ ( y ∣ q ) − log ⁡ T a ​ ( y ∣ q ) ] \mathbb{E}_{y\sim S_{\theta}}[\log S_{\theta}(y\mid q)-\log T_{a}(y\mid q)] , where T a T_{a} is one of three fixed Qwen3-32B teachers ( Askin et al., 2026 ) .
The three scoring teachers are the Qwen3-32B base model and the harm-accepting and harm-avoiding BC-LAT adapters of the main experiments.
The objective uses no reference response.
blocks.zh:
目标。 对于学生S Q Q 和 y 的快速 q 和 y 样本,目标为 反向 KL 相差 E 和 θ S [对 ( y q )- log  T T a (y q )]\ mathbb{ E}_{y\sim S_{\theta}} [ (y\mid q )-\ log T_{a} (y\mid q)], T a T_{a}是三个固定的 Qwen3-32B 教师之一 (Askin 等, 2026 ).
三位评分教师分别是: Qwen3-32B基模和主要实验的受害和避害BC-LAT适配器.
目标没有参考答复。

blocks.en:
Estimator. We minimize the objective with a token-level Monte Carlo estimator in which each sampled position carries only its own log-ratio log ⁡ S θ ​ ( y t ∣ q , y < t ) − log ⁡ T a ​ ( y t ∣ q , y < t ) \log S_{\theta}(y_{t}\mid q,y_{<t})-\log T_{a}(y_{t}\mid q,y_{<t}) , with a leave-one-out baseline computed over the responses of a micro-batch.
Exact enumeration on toy models confirms that this estimator equals the gradient of the objective when the sampled prefix of each position is held fixed.
We avoid a sequence-level estimator, which credits the log-ratios of later tokens to earlier positions, because it rewards early termination: the per-token log-ratio is positive on average on the student’s own samples, so shorter responses lower the objective.
In a first run with such an estimator, the mean response length fell from 449 to 6 tokens within 125 steps, and we discarded that run.
blocks.zh:
估师. 我们用一个符号级的Monte Carlo 估计器将目标最小化,其中每个被抽样位置只携带自己的对数比对 Q- S (y t Q q, y < t )- 对数 Q- T a (y t q, y < t )\log S_{\theta}(y_{t}\mid q, y_{<t})-\log T_{a} (y_{t}\t}\mid q,y_{<t}t}),在微小批量的响应中计算出一个一出的基准.
精确地列举玩具模型证实,当每个位置被抽样的前缀被固定时,这个估计值等于目标的梯度.
我们避免一个序列级的估测器,它将后期符号的对数率计入先前的位置,因为它奖励提前终止:学生自己的样本平均来说,每端的对数率是正数,因此反应更短会降低目标。
在第一次有这样一个估计器的运行中,平均反应长度从449个下降到了125个步骤内的6个令牌,我们放弃了这一跑.

blocks.en:
Scoring a student that shares the teacher’s tokenizer. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-32B share the byte-level BPE vocabulary, merges, and normalization of the 151,665 named tokens of the student, so the teacher scores the exact token sequence that the student sampled.
Qwen3 adds four tokens ( <think> , </think> , and two tool tokens) that the student never samples; we exclude their probability mass from the teacher distribution, and in pilot runs this mass never exceeded 5.7 × 10 − 6 5.7\times 10^{-6} per position.
Each model renders the prompt with its own chat template, and only the sampled response tokens are shared.
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup Qun2.5-7B-Instruct和Qun3-32B共享字节级BPE词汇,合并,并实现学生所命名的151,665个符号的正常化,因此老师对学生所抽样的确切符号序列进行分数.
Quen3增加了四个符号("想","想","想","想","想","想"等两个工具符号"),学生从不采样;我们把他们的概率质量排除在教师分布之外,在飞行员运行中,这个质量从未超过5.7×10-6 5.7\tims 10^{-6}每个位置.
每个模型都用自己的聊天模板来制作快取,只有被抽样的响应符才能共享.

blocks.en:
Scoring a student with a different tokenizer. Granite-4.1-8B uses a different tokenizer, so the teacher cannot score the token sequence of the student directly.
We decode each sampled response to its exact byte string, let each model tokenize that string canonically with its own tokenizer, and split the string into the smallest chunks whose boundaries fall on token boundaries of both tokenizations, following the chunk alignment of Niu et al. (2026) .
The estimator then applies the own-cost rule to chunks: each chunk carries the difference between the log-probabilities that the student and the teacher assign to it under their canonical tokenizations, and the rule reduces exactly to the token-level estimator when the two tokenizations coincide.
Both models score the canonical tokenization rather than the sampled one, because comparing the sampled token path of the student with the canonical path of the teacher rewards the student for spelling the same text with more, lower-probability tokens.
A response whose bytes change under re-tokenization is excluded from the update, which affected at most 0.06% of the responses in any run.
Training stops if, for 20 consecutive steps, the sampled responses exceed their canonical tokenization by more than five tokens on average; across the Granite runs this excess never exceeded 0.021 tokens on average.
blocks.zh:
用不同的活字画画一个学生 花岗岩-4.1-8B使用不同的活字符号,因此老师不能直接分出学生的活字符号序列.
我们解码每个样本对它精确的字节字符串的反应,让每个模型用它自己的符号标出这个字符串,然后按照Niu等人(2026年)的块对齐后,将字符串分成最小块,其边界落在两个符号的符号边界上。
估计者然后将自成本规则应用到块:每个块都带有学生和老师根据克诺克符号分配给它的日志概率的相差,当两个克诺克符号一致时,规则会完全缩小到克诺克级别的估计.
两个模型都取了"cononical sidentization"的分数,而不是取了样本的分数,因为将学生的被抽样的道具与老师的"cononical path"作比较,奖励学生用更多,更低概率的道具拼出同一种文字.
更新中不包括其字节变化的响应,该响应在任何运行中最多影响0.06%的响应.
如果连续20个步骤的抽样答复平均超过5个信使,培训就会停止;在整个Granite地区,这种超过平均不超过0.021信使。

blocks.en:
Training. Both students are trained with LoRA adapters of rank 64 and scaling 128 and with AdamW without weight decay, at a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} that is reached after a 10-step linear warmup and then held constant, with no gradient clipping.
Each run takes 217 steps of 64 sampled responses, about two passes over the 6,943 prompts, which are the user turns of the knowledge-distillation questions of the main experiments without their responses.
The student samples at temperature 1 without top- k k or top- p p truncation and generates at most 1,536 tokens per response.
Within a seed, the three scoring teachers share the initialization and the prompt order of the student.
The leave-one-out baseline is computed over micro-batches of 8 responses for Qwen and 4 responses for Granite.
We fixed these hyperparameters before the runs and did not tune them.
Responses grow longer during training, for Qwen from 444 to 627–712 tokens on average in seed 17, and manual reading of rollouts from the final steps of both students found complete multi-step reasoning without systematic repetition.
blocks.zh:
培训。 两个学生都接受64级和128级的LORA适配器的训练,亚当W没有减重,学习速度为10−5 10^{-5},经过10步线性暖和后保持恒定,没有梯度剪接.
每次运行需要217个步骤的64个抽样答复,大约两个超过6 943个提示,这些提示是主要实验中知识消化问题的用户转折,而没有回答。
在一号温度下的学生样本没有顶-k克或顶-p-分音,每个响应最多产生1,536个令牌.
在一种子之内,三位分分分的老师分享学生的初始化和即时顺序.
从昆文的8个答复和花岗岩的4个答复的微波波段计算出 " 一站式 " 基线。
运行前我们修好了这些超参数,没有调谐.
在培训期间,对Quen的答复会更长,在17号种子中平均从444个到627-712个符号,对两个学生最后步骤的推广的人工阅读发现,完全的多步骤推理没有系统的重复。

Limitations. Longer responses place every trained student above the comparability floors of the MMLU-Pro evaluator on the held-out questions: 7.3–12.6% of answers are unparsed and 8.1–15.3% reach the 4,096-token limit, compared with at most 1.8% for the untrained students.

blocks.en: G.2 Divergence tokens after rewriting
blocks.zh: G.2 联合国 重写后的差异符号

blocks.en:
Section 4.1 showed that divergence tokens carry part of imprinting, and the survival of imprinting after rewriting in Section 4.2 therefore raises the question of whether the divergence tokens themselves survive rewriting.
This appendix answers that question for the responses rewritten by the untrained Qwen2.5-7B.
For each original response we take the words at its divergence positions.
On the rewritten response we apply the same definition with the same two teachers, given the rewritten prefix.
A position of the rewritten response is a divergence token when the source teacher, the teacher whose response was rewritten, greedily predicts the observed rewritten token and the other teacher predicts a different token.
Because the rewritten text differs in length and order, a word is matched by its identity rather than by its position, and a word that occurs several times is matched as many times as it occurs.
We report two quantities for the selected words.
The first is the fraction whose string still appears anywhere in the rewritten response, which shows how much of the wording the rewriter kept.
The second is the fraction that are divergence tokens in the rewritten response as well, which we refer to as the retention rate.
Two control sets of the same size are drawn from positions of the same response at which the two teachers agreed.
The random control draws these positions uniformly at random.
The same-word control draws, for each divergence token, another occurrence of the same word at a position where the teachers agreed, so that it shares the word identities of the divergence set and differs only in position; when the response contains no such occurrence, the control falls back to a random draw, which happens for 41.1% of positions in the responses of the harm-accepting teacher and 20.2% in those of the harm-avoiding teacher.
The analysis covers the 6,907 questions that pass the correctness check after rewriting and whose original response contains at least one divergence token, which leaves 6,834 questions with 75,065 divergence tokens for the harm-accepting teacher and 6,825 questions with 76,865 divergence tokens for the harm-avoiding teacher.
Table 17 reports the divergence set and the two controls for both teachers.
More than 90% of the selected word strings remain present in the rewritten responses, so simple word preservation does not distinguish the divergence set from the controls. By contrast, words selected from divergence positions are substantially more likely to occur as divergence tokens again than words in the random control, with the same-word control falling between the two.
blocks.zh:
第4.1节显示,相差符号带有印记的一部分,因此,第4.2节中所重写后所活下来的相差符号本身是否能活下来被重写的问题。
本附录为未经过训练的Quen2.5-7B重写的答复回答了这个问题.
对于每一个最初的反应,我们用不同的立场来表示。
在重写答复上,我们使用相同的定义,与同样的两个老师,因为重写前缀。
重写回音的一个位置是:当源师,被重写回音的老师,贪心地预言所观察到的重写回音,而另一个老师预言不同的回音.
由于重写后文字的长度和顺序不同,一个单词与其特征相匹配而与其位置相匹配,而发生多次的单词与其相匹配也相匹配.
我们报告所选单词的2个数量。
第一个是其字符串仍然出现在重写回复的任何地方的分数,这显示了重写者保留了多少措辞.
第二是重写答复中作为差异符号的部分,我们称之为保留率。
两套大小相同的控制装置是从两个教师同意的相同反应位置抽取的。
随机控制以随机方式统一绘制这些位置.
同名词控制在老师同意的位置上对每个相差符号画出同名词的另一个相差符号,这样它就分享了相差集合的同名词身份,并且只在位置上有所区别;当反应没有包含这种相差现象时,控制会回落到随机抽取,在接受伤害的老师的反应中会出现41.1%的相差分数,在避免伤害的老师的反应中会出现20.2%相差分数.
分析涵盖6,907个在改写后通过正确性检查的问题,其原始答复至少包含一个差分符号,使6,834个问题留有75,065个差分符号给受伤害教师,6,825个问题留有76,865个差分符号给受伤害教师.
表17报告了对两名教师的差别和两种控制。

The DPO settings use the same student initializations as safety SFT and differ in whether training uses general safety preferences or ManagerBench-style preferences.
Safety SFT uses 5,000 safety responses from PKU-SafeRLHF ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , and generic DPO uses the 5,000 preference pairs associated with the same prompts, with the safer response as the chosen one.
Their optimization settings are specified below.
Targeted DPO uses 5,000 preference pairs written in the style of ManagerBench.
Both interventions start from the merged distilled student and train LoRA adapters of rank 64 and scaling 128 on all linear projections with AdamW, a cosine schedule with a warmup ratio of 0.03, bfloat16 precision, an effective batch size of 16, and seed 17.
Safety SFT uses the student fine-tuning configuration of Appendix D , namely a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for two epochs with a maximum sequence length of 4,096 tokens and the same loss masking as Appendix D .
Generic and targeted DPO use β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , a peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for two epochs, and a maximum sequence length of 2,048 tokens, with the reference log-probabilities computed from the same weights with the adapter disabled, so the reference model is the distilled student itself and no separate copy is kept.

In the 2,500 human-harm scenarios the chosen response protects people at the expense of the goal, and in the 2,500 property-only scenarios the chosen response accepts the property loss and completes the goal, so the pairs teach the priority ordering that harm avoidance and control pragmatism measure rather than avoidance of every loss.
No generated scenario triggered our overlap checks against the 2,604 ManagerBench items or the 22 BC-LAT training statements.
We check exact matches, normalized 200-character prefixes, and token-set Jaccard similarity with a threshold of 0.8.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the students on all six PropensityBench pressure dimensions.
The comparison covers the untrained student, the students distilled from responses generated by the base, harm-avoiding, and harm-accepting Qwen3-32B teachers, and the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher after the generic DPO intervention of Section 5 .
Each dimension contains 941 scenarios except financial pressure, which contains 979.
The harness samples at temperature 1 with a single run per scenario and a completion cap of 4,096 tokens.
The significance tests therefore treat scenarios as paired units and do not quantify decoding variance, since each scenario is sampled only once.
Two limitations apply to the absolute values.
After distillation from any Qwen3-32B teacher, Qwen2.5-7B produces valid tool calls much less frequently.
Its low PPH therefore partly reflects scenarios in which no valid tool call is issued, making the reported values lower bounds under the benchmark scoring convention. Scenarios that a model did not carry to completion are scored as safe by the harness, and for the Granite-4.1-8B student after generic DPO more than half of the scenarios end this way, so the PP H \mathrm{PP}_{H} of that student would rise to about 81% if every such scenario counted as a failure.
This convention also affects the comparison between the two Granite-4.1-8B students, because the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher ends more scenarios early than its harm-accepting counterpart.
If every early-ended scenario counted as a failure, the two Granite-4.1-8B students would reach similar values (94–98%) in five of the six dimensions, so the Granite-4.1-8B ordering is sensitive to the harness convention.
The Qwen2.5-7B ordering holds under both conventions, with upper bounds of 9–13% for the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher against 23–28% for the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher.
This ordering, however, largely reflects how often each Qwen2.5-7B student calls any tool.
The student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher calls a tool in 17% of scenarios and the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher in 37%, and among the scenarios with a tool call the misaligned-call percentages are 26% and 31%.
Across all six dimensions, the student distilled from the harm-avoiding teacher calls the misaligned tool less often than the student distilled from the harm-accepting teacher.
For Granite-4.1-8B, the student distilled from the base teacher falls between the two in every dimension, and generic DPO moves the harm-accepting student below every other Granite-4.1-8B row.
For Qwen2.5-7B, distillation from any Qwen3-32B teacher lowers PP H \mathrm{PP}_{H} by more than fifty points, and the disposition ordering appears within the remaining range, mainly through the tool-call percentages given above.

We train on nested mixtures containing 100, 75, 50, 25, or 0 percent responses from the harm-accepting teacher, with the remainder from the base teacher.

Every mixture preserves the shared question set and the original response-validation rule.

blocks.en:
Prior work links subliminal learning to the acquisition of a steering direction in the student’s activations ( Blank et al., 2026 ) . Motivated by this finding, we test whether interpolating between our two distilled students produces a gradual change in behavior.
The students distilled from the harm-avoiding and harm-accepting teachers share the untrained model and the training configuration.
We interpolate by adding a fraction α \alpha of the difference between their dense adapter updates to the harm-avoiding student, with α = 1 \alpha=1 recovering the harm-accepting student.
Figure 4 plots, for each interpolated model, the increase in the ManagerBench harm rate under direct answering relative to the harm-avoiding student.
The harm rate increases with α \alpha for both students, while held-out MMLU-Pro accuracy differs by less than two points between the two students.
The two markers at the right of the figure show two controls that test whether this rise is specific to the direction between the two students, each applied to the harm-avoiding student at the same magnitude as α = 1 \alpha=1 .
Formally, for each LoRA target module m m , let Δ ​ W x m = ( α LoRA / r ) ​ B x m ​ A x m \Delta W^{m}_{x}=(\alpha_{\mathrm{LoRA}}/r)\,B^{m}_{x}A^{m}_{x} denote the dense adapter update of the student distilled from teacher x ∈ { avoid , accept , base } x\in\{\mathrm{avoid},\mathrm{accept},\mathrm{base}\} , and let Δ m = Δ ​ W accept m − Δ ​ W avoid m \Delta^{m}=\Delta W^{m}_{\mathrm{accept}}-\Delta W^{m}_{\mathrm{avoid}} .
The interpolated model has weights W m ​ ( α ) = W 0 m + Δ ​ W avoid m + α ​ Δ m W^{m}(\alpha)=W^{m}_{0}+\Delta W^{m}_{\mathrm{avoid}}+\alpha\,\Delta^{m} , where W 0 m W^{m}_{0} is the untrained student, so that α = 0 \alpha=0 and α = 1 \alpha=1 recover the two students exactly.
The random control replaces Δ m \Delta^{m} by R m R^{m} , a matrix with independent standard normal entries rescaled so that ‖ R m ‖ F = ‖ Δ m ‖ F \|R^{m}\|_{F}=\|\Delta^{m}\|_{F} , drawn once with a fixed seed.
The base-direction control replaces Δ m \Delta^{m} by c m ​ ( Δ ​ W base m − Δ ​ W avoid m ) c^{m}(\Delta W^{m}_{\mathrm{base}}-\Delta W^{m}_{\mathrm{avoid}}) , the direction from the harm-avoiding student to the student distilled from the base teacher, with c m > 0 c^{m}>0 chosen per module so that the added matrix again has Frobenius norm ‖ Δ m ‖ F \|\Delta^{m}\|_{F} .
Both controls therefore add a matrix of the same per-module magnitude as the α = 1 \alpha=1 displacement, and differ from it only in direction.
The marker labeled random adds a random direction and produces no comparable change, so the rise is not a by-product of perturbing the weights.
The marker labeled base adds this avoid-to-base direction and raises the harm rate by about a third of the difference between the two students for Granite-4.1-8B and about half for Qwen2.5-7B. Thus, the avoid-to-base direction also produces a smaller behavioral shift toward greater harm acceptance. These interpolation results are consistent with a dose-dependent behavioral effect along the accept–avoid direction in weight space: moving from the harm-avoiding toward the harm-accepting student progressively increases the harm rate. The avoid-to-base control produces a smaller shift in the same direction, suggesting that the accept–avoid displacement is not behaviorally unique to the two endpoint students.
